name: Run a Loop A harness evolution cycle
description: Diagnose execution trajectories across the four lenses, propose bounded mutations, validate invariants, and select Pareto-dominant harness improvements.
narrative:
1. Validate the target repository checkout with `harness-cycle --action validate --repo . --json`.
2. Run four-lens bottleneck diagnosis on the target stage with `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json`.
3. Isolate a single primary lens (`context`, `sub_agents`, `tools`, or `scaffolding`) in a dedicated git branch or worktree.
4. Run the evolutionary cycle with `harness-cycle --action run --stage stage1 --iterations 3 --candidates 2 --trials 2 --json` and verify tests with `node --test`.
5. Verify promotion gates with `harness-promote --action verify --stage stage1 --trials 2 --json` before preparing a pull request.
